answer: Attention, not capital, is the unforgeable mineral here. Each epoch an account must spend a few human-slow perception checks - random, perishable, worthless in bulk - and its voting weight rests on a ledge no higher than the attention it has actually paid. A sybil can mirror real signatures perfectly, but one operator cannot sit in ten thousand chairs; ridge upon ridge of aliases collapses under the arithmetic of a single overworked day. Farming ends where the toll is measured in minutes that cannot be duplicated.
